Hero.title: Your Transformation Partner for the Age of AI
Hero.body: We help companies adapt successfully and sustainably to the challenges and opportunities that Artificial Intelligence brings.
Hero.secondaryTitle: Optimised for AI Productivity and Performance
Hero.secondaryBody: Our platform helps companies boost productivity, cut costs, and improve AI performance. It builds on existing structures to amplify results, while offering customisation, long-term reliability, and seamless model selection for every use case.

Hero.title: Creating and integrating resilient AI structures within companies
Hero.body: AI is transformative, demanding structural change across all business departments. Because of its complexity, successful integration can be challenging. With our expertise, your company can adapt sustainably and thrive in the AI era.

FounderStory.title: Founded to redefine the AI transformation landscape
FounderStory.body: TransformAI was founded by <highlight>Yergush Bloetjes</highlight> out of frustration with the slow and poorly executed way companies were adapting to the most transformative technology of our time. Combining deep theoretical knowledge, hands-on experience in the AI field, and successful integrations at other firms, he recognized the lack of high-quality solutions for business-wide AI transformation. This gap led to the creation of TransformAI, with the mission of making AI adoption both successful and sustainable.

Founder.title: Few words from our Founder
Founder.subtitle: Why we started TransformAI
Founder.body:
Hi, my name is Yergush. I founded TransformAI after seeing how many organizations struggled with the complexity and pace of AI adoption. I wanted to help build a future where businesses can truly harness the power of AI.

With TransformAI, we’re heading in the right direction. It’s inspiring to see our team grow with such talented people and to witness the impact of the projects we’ve already delivered. At the same time, there is still so much more to achieve — and that excites me. I look forward to working with future partners to keep building the future, together.

Team.title: Meet our team
Team.intro: The compactness of this team is our biggest strength, we are able to ship super fast and with excellent quality. Our team members have 10x higher productivity than employees in similar jobs who use AI, and 52x higher productivity compared to fellows who don’t use AI. Everybody is super all-round, and also specialized in certain areas at the same time, creating a high-performance environment on which I am super proud. — Yergush

yergush.name: Yergush
yergush.description: The founder of the company who ensures that the value is retained within the organisation, and makes sure that the quality delivered is nothing less than excellent. Besides managing, his primary focus is on improving current products and services.

david.name: David
david.description: The lead in exploring AI capabilities. David is constantly testing and collecting resources on the capabilities of AI systems. David also focuses on testing and creating custom integrations for companies.

tim.name: Tim
tim.description: Tim has prior experience in working in transforming corporate organisations. His knowledge is essential in finding practical solutions for companies → real world use cases. He is specialised in integrating transformation into businesses.

sara.name: Sara
sara.description: Sara is the head of Branding and Marketing. She is responsible for branding TransformAI. In the process she uses primarily AI, and this practical knowledge of implementing AI in everyday workflows especially branding and marketing makes her an essential part of the team.

jasper.name: Jasper
jasper.description: Jasper is the head of engineering and data analysis. He is an expert in handling complex engineering cases including the ones regarding data processing. He is a master in leveraging AI into software engineering tasks.

chiHueng.name: Chi-hueng
chiHueng.description: Chi-hueng is our head of the research department, researching both creating new AI use cases using custom models, and together with Jasper he handles the data analysis part of both processes and other research like sector adaptation by AI. Automating most pipelines.

aiAgents.name: AI AGENTS
aiAgents.description: Having AI as employees is a quite new phenomenon, and although they cannot handle most things autonomously yet, they are a valuable asset to the company and therefore worth mentioning. We have created systems powered by AI, which act as an employee and make our workflow so efficient meaning we can keep a compact team.

q1.title: What’s your goal with TransformAI?
q1.body: Our goal is to make AI adoption clear, structured, and achievable for every organization. Too often, businesses struggle with complexity and uncertainty. We help by creating resilient workflows, guiding strategic decisions, and ensuring AI is integrated at the right time, in the right way.

q2.title: What’s something you’re most proud of at TransformAI?
q2.body: We are proud of how we bring together research, education, and hands-on integration. Our team combines technical expertise with business understanding, which allows us to deliver practical solutions that create real value. Seeing companies become more productive and future-proof is what motivates us every day.

q3.title: What’s something that still challenges you?
q3.body: AI evolves quickly, and so do the regulations and expectations around it. One of our ongoing challenges is balancing innovation with responsibility — making sure that companies can move fast, but always with the right governance, timing, and ethical considerations.

ValuesIntro.title: Driven by values
ValuesIntro.body: AI transformation touches every part of a business — from technology to people, processes, and strategy. To maximize outcomes, we work from a set of guiding values that shape how we integrate AI sustainably and effectively.

integrityInAi.title: Integrity in AI
integrityInAi.body: We ensure that every AI integration is transparent, ethical, and aligned with your company’s values — building trust at every step.

rightTimedAdaptation.title: Right-Timed Adaptation
rightTimedAdaptation.body: We introduce AI solutions at the right phase. We never push what isn’t needed — we guide adoption where and when it delivers the most value.

reinforcingWorkforce.title: Reinforcing Workforce
reinforcingWorkforce.body: We strengthen your existing teams. Through training and support, your people stay essential, productive, and future-ready in the AI era.

innovationWithPurpose.title: Innovation with Purpose
innovationWithPurpose.body: Our research-driven approach brings cutting-edge AI to real business problems — value over hype, outcomes over buzzwords.

strategicAgility.title: Strategic Agility
strategicAgility.body: We move fast so you don’t fall behind. A lean structure enables rapid implementation and continuous improvement.

partnership.title: Partnership, not just Service
partnership.body: We don’t deliver and leave. We collaborate deeply, co-creating workflows and strategy so AI becomes a lasting advantage.

educationPlatform.label: Education platform
educationPlatform.name: Education platform
educationPlatform.title: Education platform for using AI
educationPlatform.description: We created an education platform that makes it fun and interactive to learn how to use AI within a company, with custom modules based on each partner’s needs.
educationPlatform.result: This platform has delivered massive AI productivity gains across the company.

educationCustomModules.label: Custom modules
educationCustomModules.name: Custom modules
educationCustomModules.title: Custom modules in education app
educationCustomModules.description: We created custom modules that fit each group, with a short briefing, a clear task, and hands-on work. Peers rank results; a teacher and built-in AI review them, and the AI gives personal improvement tips.

educationScaling.label: Educated 1,000+ people
educationScaling.name: Scaling AI education
educationScaling.title: Scaling AI education: from workshops to an app
educationScaling.description: Since early 2025 we’ve helped 1,000+ people strengthen AI skills and build custom solutions. This post explains why workshops didn’t scale for us and how our education app keeps quality while reaching more people.

educationNewsletter.label: Weekly updates
educationNewsletter.name: Weekly AI updates
educationNewsletter.title: Weekly AI updates newsletter
educationNewsletter.description: Stay current with a weekly roundup of what’s new in AI—beginner and advanced explanations, use cases, reviews, and on-request follow-up information so every team can act on what matters.

aiIntegrationAiTransformation.label: AI transformation
aiIntegrationAiTransformation.name: AI transformation
aiIntegrationAiTransformation.title: The AI Transition
aiIntegrationAiTransformation.description: Our view: AI is a company-wide transition, not a feature. Compounding curves in compute, capability, and adoption make a backend-first approach a necessity to create durable value and stay ready for future step-ups.
aiIntegrationAiTransformation.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.1 case study series.

aiIntegrationHrResearcher.label: HR researcher
aiIntegrationHrResearcher.name: HR researcher
aiIntegrationHrResearcher.title: 12× Faster Candidate Sourcing with AI
aiIntegrationHrResearcher.description: How an AI-powered HR researcher helped a client find suitable candidates 1200% faster, surfaced more complete lists, and reduced hiring costs—so teams reach shortlists sooner.
aiIntegrationHrResearcher.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.1 case study series.

aiIntegrationEmailResponder.label: Email responder
aiIntegrationEmailResponder.name: Email responder
aiIntegrationEmailResponder.title: AI email responder case study
aiIntegrationEmailResponder.description: Custom AI responders trimmed daily email work by 75%+ and lifted reply rates by 50%+. We’re also building a more universal solution informed by these projects.
aiIntegrationEmailResponder.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.1 case study series.

aiIntegrationCustomLocalModel.label: Custom local model
aiIntegrationCustomLocalModel.name: Custom local model
aiIntegrationCustomLocalModel.title: Custom local deployed model
aiIntegrationCustomLocalModel.description: In our case study, a custom AI classifier reached 79% vs 80% human correctness while cutting effort from 24h to 1h (>95% calculated cost savings), meeting strict format and confidentiality requirements.
aiIntegrationCustomLocalModel.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.1 case study series.

aiIntegrationImageWorkflow.label: AI image workflow
aiIntegrationImageWorkflow.name: Optimized AI foto workflow
aiIntegrationImageWorkflow.title: From 20h to 45m: Scalable AI Image Workflows
aiIntegrationImageWorkflow.description: How a custom platform with parallel generations and prompt memory cut labor from 20 hours (manual) and 7 hours (normal AI) to 45 minutes for the same-quality image.
aiIntegrationImageWorkflow.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.1 case study series.

aiIntegrationPt2CompanyFinder.label: Company Finder
aiIntegrationPt2CompanyFinder.name: Company Finder
aiIntegrationPt2CompanyFinder.title: AI search for B2B outreach
aiIntegrationPt2CompanyFinder.description: Our agent uses tool calling to scan the public web, match companies to your criteria, and return legitimate contact routes—built with ethics and compliance in mind.
aiIntegrationPt2CompanyFinder.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.2 case study series.

aiIntegrationPt2Backend.label: Backend
aiIntegrationPt2Backend.name: Backend
aiIntegrationPt2Backend.title: Backend AI Integration: Why It Comes First
aiIntegrationPt2Backend.description: Backend is where value is created—across finance, support, sales, HR, IT, and risk. Our phased view focuses on outcomes (integrated → internalised → adaptive) and explains why backend-first multiplies front-end results, while avoiding mis-adoption, skipped steps, and lock-in.
aiIntegrationPt2Backend.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.2 case study series.

aiIntegrationPt2Frontend.label: Frontend
aiIntegrationPt2Frontend.name: Frontend
aiIntegrationPt2Frontend.title: Front-End AI Integration: Products, Revenue & Market Share
aiIntegrationPt2Frontend.description: Front end is where capability becomes revenue. We explain how it differs from backend, what “front end” includes in practice, the outcome-based phases (AI-Integrated → AI-Internalised → AI-Adaptive), key product-side risks, and how it runs in parallel with backend to defend and grow share.
aiIntegrationPt2Frontend.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.2 case study series.

aiIntegrationPt2AgenticResearcher.label: Agentic Researcher
aiIntegrationPt2AgenticResearcher.name: Agentic Researcher
aiIntegrationPt2AgenticResearcher.title: Agentic AI Research
aiIntegrationPt2AgenticResearcher.description: Our human-in-the-loop workflow lets PhD-level AI researcher handle repetitive tasks—saving ~10 minutes per data point—while researchers make the big calls, scaling to millions of data points.
aiIntegrationPt2AgenticResearcher.result: Part of our AI Integration Pt.2 case study series.

researchAiAdoption.label: AI adoption
researchAiAdoption.name: AI adoption.
researchAiAdoption.title: Research in AI adoption by companies
researchAiAdoption.description: We’re conducting research into how industries adopt AI—where it’s used, how fast it’s spreading, how deeply it’s integrated, and what results it delivers. Using surveys and AI-assisted evidence gathering, we compile clear sector snapshots with trends and notable anomalies. These findings help teams prioritize next steps and reduce risk.

researchCustomModels.label: Custom AI models
researchCustomModels.name: Training custom models
researchCustomModels.title: We Research when to Train Custom AI Models
researchCustomModels.description: Not every task fits a general model. In this study, we test where custom training actually pays off—measuring quality, latency, and cost against real business value. We compare strong baselines (prompts + RAG) to fine-tuned and distilled models, and share the decision rules we use to pick the cheapest reliable path.

researchTimeSeries.label: Time-series prediction
researchTimeSeries.name: AI time-series prediction
researchTimeSeries.title: Can LLMs forecast?
researchTimeSeries.description: We explore whether transformer LLMs can forecast variables over time—testing how semantic labels, model size, and light fine-tuning affect accuracy and stability. A spotlight on “From Tokens to Temperatures” shows sizable gains when inputs carry meaning, with outliers sharply reduced.

researchRanking.label: AI recommendation ranking
researchRanking.name: Influencing AI output
researchRanking.title: Ranking in AI model recommendations
researchRanking.description: We study how AI assistants decide which products and services to include—and in what order. Our benchmark tests across multiple providers examine signals like evidence clarity, third-party corroboration, and policy alignment. Early results show relative lifts of ~72%, 89%, and 75% in inclusion and visibility.
